cohort: Families with 11,134 infants born in Ireland between December 2007 and May 2008 were randomly selected and recruited to the Growing Up in Ireland study.
finding: At age 9 months, elective CS was associated with delays in personal social skills and gross motor function, and emergency CS was associated with delayed gross motor function; however, at age 3 years, no significantly increased risk of an abnormal total SDQ score was found across all modes of delivery.
mod_finding: Elective Cesarean section was associated with delays in personal social skills and gross motor function at 9 months, while emergency Cesarean section was associated with delayed gross motor function at 9 months, but no increased risk of an abnormal total SDQ score was observed at 3 years across any mode of delivery.
